title: NL mapper: omit-detail create intents shadowed by list/search/lookalike actions

method.scope: local mapper probes only — no prod writes

code_paths.args_gate: match_segment skips candidates when _extract_args returns None (lines 83–85)
code_paths.read_permissive: _extract_args kind==read always gets query/limit for search/list (lines 270–283)
code_paths.write_fallthrough: WRITE_VERBS → {"payload": {"intent_text": text}} for any unmatched write/advanced (lines 429–430)
code_paths.apollo_boost: LIST_CREATE_INTENT +40 lists.create / −40 list+contact lookalikes (lines 219–234) — does not keep create when args missing

class_verdict.summary: Structural class bug, not one-offs. Strict create extractors return None on omit-detail; those high-score creates are dropped; any other write/advanced with WRITE_VERBS fallthrough (or a lookalike phrase boost) wins. Apollo scoring mitigations only change relative scores — they do not preserve create identity when args fail.

root_patterns.description: Correct *.create scores highest but _extract_args returns None → candidate discarded
Generic WRITE_VERBS payload lets update/delete/stories/comment/drafts/labels win at equal base write score
Substring/phrase boosts match wrong resource (e.g. 'contact list' → contacts.create)
When create does pass args gate, name/title regex over-captures ('named Review' → name 'named Review')
HubSpot has no lists.create in chat matrix — only lists.add_contact — so list-create NL cannot bind correctly

class_verdict.recommendation_detail: Prefer shared catalog-kind authority over per-scenario score tweaks: when write/create intent is clear and the top-scoring create candidate fails only on missing required args, keep that action_key identity and route to clarify/auto-plan (inferred_fields / assumption_notes) — never silent fallthrough via intent_text payload to lookalike update/list/search/stories. Per-integration boosts (Apollo LIST_CREATE_INTENT) are insufficient and already proven incomplete for omit-name. Secondary: tighten phrase boundaries (contact list ≠ contact) and title extractors; add HubSpot list-create only if catalog supports it.
class_verdict.not_recommended_as_primary: Per-scenario score patches alone (Apollo-style ±40) — they still lose when args gate drops the create candidate

table.message: Create a contact list in HubSpot.
table.expected_action: hubspot.lists.create (not in chat matrix; only hubspot.lists.add_contact exists)
table.notes: Regex create (hubspot )?contacts? matches inside 'contact list'; +22 boost. Highest create candidate for lists does not exist in catalog. contacts.search also scores 44 via read permissive query='in'.
Intentional placeholder when omit email — args gate passes via create-contact regex. Not a shadow case.

Placeholder dealname. Fragile: deals.delete/update/update_stage also score 30 via write_intent_text_fallthrough; create wins only because it appears first among ties after its dedicated extractor succeeds.

asana.tasks.create scores 42 (+16/+20 create-task boosts) but _extract_asana_task_args returns None (no title after 'task'). Dropped by args gate. First equal-score write with intent_text fallthrough wins: stories.create.

table.message: Create a task in Asana named Review.
table.notes: Correct action wins, but title regex captures 'named Review' instead of 'Review'. Not classic list/search shadow.
issues.create scores 30 but requires quoted summary (and optional project) — returns None. issues.update is first matrix entry among equal-score OK writes (comment/transition/assign also tied).

table.message: Create a Jira issue titled Bug.

payload.intent_text: Create a Jira issue titled Bug.

table.notes: Title extractor only accepts quoted summary — 'titled Bug' not parsed. Same shadow as omit case.
messages.send requires email address → None. drafts.create wins first among equal-score fallthrough writes (labels.create, threads.modify, etc. also tied).
Action key correct, but only via generic intent_text fallthrough — no dedicated drafts extractor. Fragile vs labels.create at same score.
Control — dedicated slack post_message scoring (+20) and args (channel default general) keep correct action.

extra_probes.message: In Apollo, create a contact list.

payload.intent_text: In Apollo, create a contact list.

extra_probes.notes: lists.create scores 72 (LIST_CREATE_INTENT +40) but omit-name → args None → still shadowed. Mapper-level FAIL; Wave 6–7 process_turn fallthrough/auto-plan is outside match_segment. Named variant 'Create a contact list in Apollo named MSP Prospects.' correctly matches lists.create.
Same class: items.create needs item_name; omit → None; update wins via intent_text. 'Create a Monday task named Review.' also fails create extractor (vendor token between 'a' and 'task').

extra_probes.message: Create a HubSpot contact named Jane.
extra_probes.notes: Related extractor gap: named Jane ignored; placeholder firstname used. Not a shadow, but same omit-detail fragility family.
